metadata.case_name: LEE CHUNG AND ANOTHER v. PANG LAP HUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Taxi driver (owns his own taxi). 2nd Plaintiff rents the taxi from the 1st Plaintiff for the night shifts.

source: He had a 1 cm. cut over his forehead and his left shoulder was tender.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Tenderness of left shoulder (soft tissue injury)
source: He had a 1 cm. cut over his forehead and his left shoulder was tender.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: Brief loss of consciousness following the accident; observed for possible post-concussional syndrome
source: He was unconscious after the accident and regained consciousness immediately upon admission.
He was discharged 2 days later but attended the Neurosurgical Unit for a further month in order to detect any post-concussional syndrome, should one develop.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with loss of consciousness, short duration of less than 30 minutes

manifestations.description: Unconscious after the accident, regained consciousness immediately upon admission
Attended the Neurosurgical Unit for a further month to detect any post-concussional syndrome (none developed)
Returned to the health he enjoyed before the accident (no post-concussional syndrome developed)

treatments_received: Admitted to hospital immediately following the accident
Observation/attendance at the Neurosurgical Unit for a further month
Traditional medicine: 6 prescriptions (Yan Wo Tong Dispensary)

losses.description: Pain suffering and loss of amenities (general damages awarded $4,000.00)
